best_idea: Route every client command through one gate that overwrites the actor with the session's bound character, refuses server-only verbs, dry-runs the command, and drains a fixed per-client budget from a capped FIFO backlog.
decision_why: Take the identity stamp, the server-only refusal, dry-run-before-commit and the per-client budget with a capped backlog. Reject the lockstep distribution, because Frankendom's server sends state and kills are server-verified.
acceptance: A server test sends a fight packet naming another character's id and gets refused with the world unchanged; five engage packets in one tick run two and carry three to the next tick in order; the seventeenth queued packet is refused as backlog full.
